zh.title: 美國航空開辦紐約JFK至歐洲10條直飛航線
zh.summary: 美國航空將開辦紐約JFK至歐洲10條直飛航線，預計2027年新增2個航點。
body: 美國航空（American Airlines）正著手擴展其從紐約甘迺迪國際機場（JFK）前往歐洲地區的國際航線網路。根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 6 日發布的報導資訊，該航空公司將開辦 10 條從紐約甘迺迪國際機場直飛歐洲的航線服務。
在此次航線規劃中，美國航空預計將於 2027 年在其航網中新增兩個全新的歐洲航點。此項航線拓展計畫涵蓋了美國航空從紐約甘迺迪國際機場營運至歐洲地區的多項直飛航線服務。

en.title: American Airlines to Launch 10 Nonstop Routes From New York-JFK (JFK) to Europe
en.summary: American Airlines plans ten nonstop routes from New York-JFK to Europe including two new destinations in 2027.
body: American Airlines is expanding its international route network from New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport to Europe. According to information published by Simple Flying on September 6, 2026, the major U.S. carrier is launching 10 nonstop routes connecting its New York-JFK (JFK) hub with destination points across Europe.

The airline's operational planning includes expanding its overall European presence over the coming years, with two new international destinations scheduled to be added to its service network in 2027. The news outlines American Airlines' direct transatlantic flight services operating between New York-JFK and European markets.

zh.title: 美軍林肯號航空母艦結束泰國訪問；重新展開第7艦隊任務
zh.summary: 林肯號航空母艦於9月6日離開泰國；結束5天休整並恢復第7艦隊常規任務
body: 美國海軍尼米茲級核動力航空母艦林肯號（USS Abraham Lincoln）於2026年9月6日確認已離開泰國林查班（Laem Chabang），結束為期5天的休整停留，重新展開在美國海軍第7艦隊轄區的常規任務。林肯號為第3航空母艦打擊群（CSG 3）的旗艦。
林肯號航空母艦於9月2日抵達泰國，此前該艦已在海上執行長達286天的部署，期間曾參與霍爾木茲海峽的封鎖行動。在泰國停留期間，近5000名水兵與海軍陸戰隊員前往是拉差（Sri Racha）及芭達雅（Pattaya）地區，透過美軍士氣福利暨娛樂計畫參與當地行程。
林肯號艦長基勒上校（Dan Keeler）表示，此次港口訪問為官兵提供了寶貴的休整機會，並感謝泰國方面的盛情款待。美軍隨後將繼續與泰國及區域盟友共同執行第7艦隊防務任務。

en.title: USS Abraham Lincoln Departs Thailand to Resume US 7th Fleet Operations
en.summary: USS Abraham Lincoln departed Thailand on September 6 after a five-day port visit to resume operations.
body: The Nimitz-class nuclear-powered aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln departed Laem Chabang, Thailand, on September 6, 2026, to resume routine operations within the US 7th Fleet. The flagship of Carrier Strike Group 3 completed a five-day port visit aimed at allowing the crew to recharge after extended sea duty.

The aircraft carrier arrived in Thailand on September 2, 2026, following a 286-day deployment at sea that included participation in the naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz. During the port visit, nearly 5,000 sailors and marines visited the Sri Racha and Pattaya regions through events organized by the US Navy's Morale, Welfare, and Recreation program alongside local businesses.

US Navy Capt. Dan Keeler, Commanding Officer of USS Abraham Lincoln, thanked Thai hosts for their hospitality, noting that the break was a key highlight for the strike group as personnel prepare to continue their regional operational mission.
